data.gender_notes: Santonu is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Santona is a Goddess name, in Sanskrit and Bengali, meaning 'Goddess of fertility and prosperity'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Santana' meaning 'continuous' or 'everlasting'. This name signifies the power and strength of the Goddess, who is believed to bring about new life and abundance. The name Santonu carries the meaning “Goddess of fertility and prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali. Parents who choose Santonu usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of fertility and prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
